item.summary: fix(gateway): in-flight run adoption resolves the agent-scoped canonical key (#123539) chat.history/chat.startup re-resolved the canonical key without agent scoping even though the correctly scoped key was already computed during session load. For bare alias keys with a non-default agent, the unscoped resolve fell back to the default agent, missed the abort entry's stored key, and dropped the in-flight snapshot: switch back mid-run rendered idle and the streamed reply never appeared until manual refresh. Pass the already-computed canonicalKey; delete the redundant resolve.
